a cache family member that the `cache` best-practice holds no floor for.

`.ifInstalled()` reads an undeclared member as "not used", so a member below any version passes
`plan` unseen. this bad-practice names each such member instead.

- a retired member (`with-simple-caching`) moves to its successor (`with-simple-cache`) once no src
  file imports it; a src import of it gets a `// @declapract:review:` line that names the move
- a member this practice does not know stays in place, named by `plan`, until a floor for it lands
  in `cache/best-practice/package.json` (and in `CACHE_FAMILY_MEMBERS_FLOORED`, which a test holds
  equal to those floors)
